definition: Seemingly convincing or attractive but actually false or misleading.
author: Henry James
quote: Wasn’t there light in the fact which, as we shared our solitude, broke out with a specious glitter it had never yet quite worn?
example_sentence: The advert made a specious claim about doubling your energy.
